    • queryParamFormatter

      public static final DateTimeFormatter queryParamFormatter
      Formats a date-time query/body parameter in the API's yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' shape.

      The input must be UTC wall clock — which is the SDK-wide convention: the core LocalDateTimeDeserializer parses "...T12:00:00Z" into a bare LocalDateTime of 12:00, so every timestamp the SDK returns is already UTC wall clock and can be formatted here verbatim. The trailing 'Z' is a literal, not an offset: this formatter performs no zone conversion, so formatting a zone-local LocalDateTime (e.g. LocalDateTime.now()) would stamp local wall-clock digits with a UTC designator. For the current time use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC), or format an Instant via LocalDateTime.ofInstant(instant, ZoneOffset.UTC).

  • Method Details

    • mapper

      public static com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper()
      The shared wire ObjectMapper used for all SDK request/response (de)serialization.

      Do not reconfigure the returned instance. Its configuration is frozen at class-initialization time and it is used concurrently by every SDK thread; calling configure/registerModule/setSerializationInclusion (or similar) on it is a thread-safety violation and silently changes SDK-wide behaviour. Treat it as read-only: use it for readValue/writeValueAsString/convertValue or derive an immutable handle via reader()/writer().

      Returns:
      the shared, fully configured wire mapper

    • converter

      public static com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper converter()
      The shared object-to-object conversion ObjectMapper (used to seed updater JSON models from fetched resources via convertValue; never used for wire traffic).

      Do not reconfigure the returned instance — same contract as mapper().

      Returns:
      the shared, fully configured conversion mapper
